items.title: How Long Does It Take to Build $1,600 a Month in Dividend Income on $1,000 a Month in Savings?
items.summary: Saving $1,000 a month sounds disciplined until you realize a zero-return account takes 34 years to reach your income goal. The right portfolio blend collapses that timeline dramatically, but the yield you chase determines whether your income grows or quietly erodes.
